fidelity: F2a — Dynamic Thermal-Mass (Lumped) with Thermostat Control
source: ASHRAE Handbook HVAC Systems & Equipment (2020), Ch. 32 'Boilers'; Incropera & DeWitt (2007) Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Ch. 5 'Lumped Capacitance'; cp_water from NIST/IAPWS-95 (Wagner & Pruss, 2002).

unit.name: 30 kW residential/light-commercial electric resistance boiler — lumped thermal mass

P_rated_kw.note: Rated electrical input of resistance/electrode element

eta_elec.note: Electrical-to-thermal conversion efficiency of element (resistance heating ~99%)

m_vessel_kg.note: Metal vessel mass contributing to thermal mass

cp_vessel.note: Specific heat of carbon steel vessel (Incropera 2007)

cp_water.note: Specific heat of liquid water near 60C (NIST/IAPWS-95, Wagner & Pruss 2002)

UA_loss.note: Standby loss conductance (jacket UA) to ambient
